title: Download a poster
text: Open a poster from Selected work, change the headline or palette, then choose Export PNG. Your current design downloads as a 900 x 1125 pixel PNG.

title: Save your design
text: Choose Save draft in the poster editor. Open saved draft restores it in the same browser. Drafts do not sync across devices. If saving fails, keep the page open and export a PNG. File-URL storage can behave differently between browsers.

title: Explore the three studies
text: The three studies are Form & Rhythm and Open Studio in Type, and Blue Hour in Composition. Choose All to see every study, or a category to narrow the collection. Studio Launch is a fictional workshop portfolio.
